title: Fate models of nanoparticles in the environment: a critical review and prospects
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3394-3412
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00342C, Critical Review
Ruiyu Zhang, Xiaoxin Zheng, Wenhong Fan, Xiangrui Wang, Tianhui Zhao, Xiaoli Zhao, Willie J. G. M. Peijnenburg, Martina G. Vijver, Ying Wang
Herein, we systematically reviewed the environmental fate models of nanoparticles from the perspective of mathematical methods and proposed an optimal modeling process for simulating the fate of nanoparticles.
